Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.
